entities.summary: Zaiga Jansone-Ivanova is a former Soviet Latvian tennis player and tennis coach. She was a five-time Soviet champion in women's doubles, 1973 Summer Universiade champion in women's doubles and winner of the exhibition tennis event of 1968 Olympics in mixed doubles.
